QUOTE: The only dynamic check is `MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_VALGRIND` and `_MEMSAN` (`mbedtls_config.h:2109-2142`). These are off by default.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer names the off-by-default valgrind/MemSan testing facility but never says it is explicitly not part of the library API, so the item's second half is missing.
